title: Feel the burn: why holidays from hell make for blistering fiction

paragraphs.en: Every summer, we long for a much-needed break from daily life, dreaming of self-reinvention in some distant paradise. But really, holidays can be absolute hell. Instead of relaxation we encounter heaving crowds, lumpy beds, the caprices of our loved ones and the grim truth that we can escape neither their worst failings nor our own, however far we travel.
paragraphs.zh: 每年夏天，我们都渴望从日常生活中抽身休息，梦想在某个遥远的天堂重塑自我。但实际上，假期可能完全是场噩梦。我们遇到的不是放松，而是拥挤的人群、凹凸不平的床铺、所爱之人的反复无常，以及一个残酷的事实：无论我们走多远，都无法摆脱他们最糟糕的缺点，也无法摆脱我们自己的。

paragraphs.en: Small wonder, then, that the disaster holiday has become a booming subgenre in fiction. For most of us, the levels of luxury promised by hit TV series The White Lotus are pure fantasy, yet we’re all vulnerable to the expensive promises we’ve been sold. Two of the smartest offerings in fiction this summer come from Claire Powell’s All In and Chloë Ashby’s Family Friends. In the former, a struggling couple whose marriage is on the rocks go on an all-inclusive Spanish weekend break, paid for by a rich brother. Poignant and extremely funny, the frictions that ensue are all too believable.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，灾难假期成为小说中蓬勃发展的一个分支题材也就不足为奇了。对大多数人来说，热播剧《白莲花度假村》所承诺的那种奢华纯粹是幻想，但我们都很容易被推销给我们的昂贵承诺打动。今年夏天最聪明的两部小说作品来自克莱尔·鲍威尔的《All In》和克洛伊·阿什比的《Family Friends》。在前者中，一对婚姻濒临破裂、苦苦挣扎的夫妇去西班牙度了一个全包式周末假期，由富有的兄弟买单。随之而来的摩擦既令人心酸又极其好笑，真实得让人难以置信。

paragraphs.en: So, too, is the implosion of Ashby’s group of friends who have a decades-long custom of holidaying together in the south of France. This year, however, their marriages are threatened by one husband’s deceit, the lingering attraction between old friends and the arrival of a vivacious teenage stepdaughter. Poised and gripping, it uses a sweltering Mediterranean setting to amp up tensions to dramatic effect.
paragraphs.zh: 阿什比笔下那群朋友的内讧也是如此——他们几十年来一直有一起在法国南部度假的习惯。然而今年，他们的婚姻受到一位丈夫的欺骗、老朋友之间挥之不去的吸引力，以及一位活力四射的少女继女到来的威胁。这部小说从容而扣人心弦，利用地中海酷热难耐的背景把紧张气氛推向了戏剧性的高潮。

paragraphs.en: In Sabine Durrant’s superb thriller Dead Heat, meanwhile, a failed journalist, his more successful media friend and a former school contemporary, now a Gatsbyesque billionaire, find their Greek adventure transformed not only into a shameful reminder of racism in their shared past, but something outright murderous. Being thrown together to brave blazing summer heat only intensifies existing tensions as Durrant expertly brings the drama to a head.
paragraphs.zh: 与此同时，在萨宾·杜兰特的出色惊悚小说《Dead Heat》中，一名失败的记者、他更成功的媒体界朋友，以及一位如今已是盖茨比式亿万富翁的老同学发现，他们的希腊之旅不仅变成了对他们共同过去中种族主义的一次难堪的提醒，更演变成了彻头彻尾的杀机。被凑到一起忍受炎炎夏日的酷热，只会加剧已有的紧张关系，杜兰特娴熟地将这场戏剧推向高潮。

paragraphs.en: Many characters seeking escape find that a change of scene only makes problems worse. Deborah Levy’s Hot Milk , adapted as a film last year by Rebecca Lenkiewicz, chronicles a family unravelling in a Spanish fishing village. Rose pays thousands to a clinic to cure her mysterious paralysis while Sofia distracts herself with local beauty, Ingrid, as unresolved conflicts between mother and daughter start to boil over.
paragraphs.zh: 许多寻求逃避的角色发现，换个环境只会让问题变得更糟。去年由丽贝卡·伦凯维奇改编成电影的黛博拉·利维的《热牛奶》，讲述了一个家庭在西班牙渔村中逐渐分崩离析的故事。罗斯花费数千元在一家诊所治疗她那神秘的瘫痪症，而索菲亚则用与当地美女英格丽德的交往来转移注意力，与此同时，母女之间未解决的冲突开始愈演愈烈。

paragraphs.en: A fateful holiday also inspires the scathing, semi-autobiographical play in Jo Hamya’s novel The Hypocrite . Sophia is taken out of school to act as her novelist father’s amanuensis, though he spends much of his time in Sicily seducing local women instead of bonding with his daughter. Years later, he is appalled to see that Sophia has adapted his parenting failures for the stage, though the novel cleverly hints at aspects of her own behaviour on that holiday which Sophia may have conveniently chosen to forget.
paragraphs.zh: 一场宿命般的假期也启发了乔·哈米亚小说《The Hypocrite》中那部辛辣的半自传体戏剧。索菲亚被从学校接走，去给小说家父亲当抄写助手，尽管他把大部分时间都花在西西里勾引当地女性上，而不是与女儿培养感情。多年后，他惊恐地发现索菲亚把他的育儿失败改编上了舞台，不过这部小说巧妙地暗示，索菲亚在那个假期里的某些行为，她可能也选择性地遗忘了。

paragraphs.en: The fancier the surroundings, the worse a fictional holiday is likely to be. In William Rayfet Hunter’s Sunstruck , an invitation to his university friend Lily’s parents’ chateau is the catalyst for unwelcome epiphanies about the class and race differences between the narrator and Lily’s family, even as he becomes involved with her wayward brother. Lucy Foley’s The Midnight Feast also plays with this trope to great effect, when the opening weekend of a high-end wellness retreat in the West Country is disrupted by revelations from a guest’s disastrous stay many years before.
paragraphs.zh: 环境越豪华，小说中的假期往往就越糟糕。在威廉·雷费特·亨特的《Sunstruck》中，收到大学朋友莉莉父母的城堡邀请，成了引发叙述者与莉莉一家之间阶层和种族差异令他不快顿悟的催化剂，与此同时他还卷入了与莉莉任性的哥哥的纠葛。露西·福利的《The Midnight Feast》也把这个套路运用得淋漓尽致：英格兰西部一处高端养生度假村开业的第一个周末，被多年前一位客人灾难性住宿经历的曝光所搅乱。

paragraphs.en: Our attempts to get away from it all can often lead us right back to what we left home to avoid. In Deepa Anappara’s ambitious, multilayered The Last of Earth , Victorian adventurer Katherine hopes her journey into the forbidden kingdom of Tibet will help her overcome difficult feelings about her heritage. Unfortunately, disguising herself as a male pilgrim to cross dangerous unknown terrain only serves to underline Katherine’s alienation as she attempts to become the first European woman to reach Lhasa.
paragraphs.zh: 我们试图逃离一切的努力，往往恰恰会把我们带回离家时想要躲避的东西。在迪帕·阿纳帕拉的野心之作、多层叙事的小说《The Last of Earth》中，维多利亚时代的冒险家凯瑟琳希望她深入被禁止进入的西藏王国的旅程，能帮助她克服对自己身世的复杂情感。不幸的是，乔装成男性朝圣者穿越危险而陌生的地形，反而更加凸显了凯瑟琳的疏离感，因为她试图成为第一位抵达拉萨的欧洲女性。
